Full summary: Task 16 (inline): hash routing shipped (js/router.js) — tab/view/scope/filter/selection/range/anchor in the URL; pushState for tab/sel/anchor (back button restores views), replaceState for filter tweaks; deep-link reload verified at 5k (blackboard + src/ scope + warning facet -> 932 records restored), back-button restore verified. Filter keys sanitized (kinds/scope stripped from f= param).
Findings: Verification gotcha: Playwright goto to the same URL with a different hash does NOT reload the page — the first deep-link test read stale DOM from the previous page state and looked like a routing bug; a true reload showed routing working. Applies to any future hash-based UI verification.
